page.notes: Greek passages are set in a smaller italic or irregular hand and are transcribed from a low-resolution scan; the Greek words in the parenthetical opening lines of the Dionysia and Mysteria paragraphs, the Pollux citation and the Greek opening of the last paragraph are doubtful and should be checked against the original. The reading "ὃ ὅπ" and the words after "τῷ σίτῳ" are especially uncertain. The Greek in the last paragraph ("Μεριστεὸς" and "Θιώτας") is also doubtful. The word "Βουδρομιῶνος" may be "Βοηδρομιῶνος". The ligature "ꝛ" in the signature is read as "2". The source line ends with "ap-" and continues on the next page; the page has no catchword.
